ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the corruption
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is behind the fraud and how are they being held accountable?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale corruption scheme and bring about justice for those affected. I recommend starting with a review of public records and interviewing whistleblowers.
